children: The proposed acquisition would deepen business banking expertise and expand Peak's reach into Arizona and New Mexico

EUGENE, Ore. and LACEY, Wash. and SCOTTSDALE, Ariz., Nov. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Peak Credit Union announced today that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire all assets and assume all liabilities of Southwest Heritage Bank, a subsidiary of Bancorp 34, Inc. (

The proposed acquisition would bring together Peak's broad consumer financial services and member-owned cooperative model with Southwest Heritage's commercial lending expertise, treasury management services, and established business relationships across Arizona and New Mexico. The combination is intended to expand the financial resources available to individuals and business owners while preserving the local expertise and personal relationships valued by Southwest Heritage customers.

"Our focus is on finding meaningful ways to serve more people," said Dr. David L. Tuyo II, president and CEO of Peak Credit Union. "We know many of our members already spend part of the year in Arizona, making it a natural place for us to grow. Southwest Heritage has built trusted relationships with local businesses, backed by people who understand their communities. Bringing that expertise together with Peak's broader capabilities gives us an opportunity to help more people and businesses move toward their financial goals."

Over time, Peak members could benefit from deeper commercial lending and treasury management capabilities, while Southwest Heritage customers could gain access to additional consumer financial services. Specific products, eligibility, and timing will be determined as integration planning progresses.

The employees and relationships of Southwest Heritage Bank are central to the value of the planned transition. Peak intends to retain Southwest Heritage employees at closing, subject to ordinary business and individual circumstances, to support service continuity and integration. Peak also intends to retain members of Southwest Heritage's executive leadership team in senior roles. Final roles and reporting relationships remain subject to approval and integration planning.

There are no immediate changes to branch operations, accounts, or banking services as a result of today's announcement. Until the transaction closes, the two organizations are expected to continue to operate independently, and members and customers do not need to take any action. It is expected that Peak will communicate any future changes directly and in advance.

The boards of directors of Peak Credit Union, Southwest Heritage Bank and Bancorp 34, Inc. approved the agreement unanimously. The transaction remains subject to customary regulatory and shareholder approvals and is expected to close in the second half of 2027.

Following closing, Southwest Heritage Bank and Bancorp 34, Inc. is expected to dissolve and distribute the remaining assets of Bancorp 34, Inc. to its shareholders in accordance with the transaction terms.

D.A. Davidson & Co. served as financial advisor and Otteson Shapiro LLP served as legal counsel to Southwest Heritage Bank and Bancorp 34, Inc. McQueen Financial Advisors served as financial advisor and Luse Gorman, PC served as legal counsel to Peak Credit Union.
